extractions.value: Initial misdiagnosis as psychogenic dystonia and later presumed Lyme disease. Patient is male with anti-amphiphysin positive SPS and breast cancer, both rare in males. Malignancy not detected until 3 years after symptom onset despite extensive workup. Cyclophosphamide provided significant improvement before cancer diagnosis. Taxane-based chemotherapy avoided due to concern for peripheral neuropathy.
